overview:
This check monitors [Neutrona][1] cloud connectivity services to:

- Azure (ExpressRoute)

[1]: https://telemetry.neutrona.com
setup:
The Neutrona check is not included in the [Datadog Agent][2] package, so you need to install it.

### Installation

For Agent v7.21+ / v6.21+, follow the instructions below to install the Neutrona check on your host. See [Use Community Integrations][3] to install with the Docker Agent or earlier versions of the Agent.

1. Run the following command to install the Agent integration:

   ```shell
   datadog-agent integration install -t datadog-neutrona==<INTEGRATION_VERSION>
   ```

2. Configure your integration similar to core [integrations][4].

### Configuration

1. Edit the `neutrona.d/conf.yaml` file in the `conf.d/` folder at the root of your [Agent's configuration directory][7] to start collecting your Neutrona [metrics](#metrics).
   See the [sample neutrona.d/conf.yaml][8] for all available configuration options.

2. [Restart the Agent][9]

### Validation

[Run the Agent's status subcommand][10] and look for `neutrona` under the Checks section.

metrics.name: neutrona.azure.expressroute.egress_bps
metrics.description: Bits per second transmitted towards Azure over the ExpressRoute peering

metrics.name: neutrona.azure.expressroute.egress_interface_errors
metrics.description: Presence or absence of egress errors in the ExpressRoute NNI (Network-to-Network Interface)

metrics.name: neutrona.azure.expressroute.ingress_bps
metrics.description: Bits per second received from Azure over the ExpressRoute peering

metrics.name: neutrona.azure.expressroute.ingress_interface_errors
metrics.description: Presence or absence of ingress errors in the ExpressRoute NNI (Network-to-Network Interface)

metrics.name: neutrona.azure.expressroute.output_optical_power
metrics.description: Output optical power measured at the ExpressRoute NNI (Network-to-Network Interface)

metrics.name: neutrona.azure.expressroute.receiver_optical_power
metrics.description: Input optical power measured at the ExpressRoute NNI (Network-to-Network Interface)
